faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NII Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 20th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in any area of Life Sciences or a Master's degree with a minimum of three years of relevant experience. A first-author publication in a reputed journal is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 56,000/- plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 100/- for General and OBC category candidates. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the National Institute of Immunology located?
faq.answer: The National Institute of Immunology is located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the National Institute of Immunology.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for your reference.
